August 31, 2026
Starting later today, advertisers can purchase ChatGPT ads directly via Ads Manager across India, Europe, the Middle East, and North Africa.
ChatGPT Ads are now available in over 40 countries through the OpenAI Ads Solutions team and our agency and technology partners.
Ads in ChatGPT are always clearly labeled and separate from ChatGPT’s answers. Advertising does not influence the answers ChatGPT provides.
Our ads system uses the context of the current conversation to show an ad relevant to what someone is exploring.
